elaine: quick follow-up from the outage postmortem. we need owners for canary/flag hardening items. keeping this thread short.
sophie: agree. propose HOT (1w), NEAR (3w).
jamal: ok. i'll take console scoping + audit events. ETA: 2026-04-06.
anya: i'll own emergency opt-out flag + runtime fallback to safe-model pool. target: 2026-03-31.
mike: i'll own auto-rollback controller + tests. suggested conditions: error_rate >= 2% for 3m OR p95 latency > 2s for 2m. will push PR by 2026-04-02.
sophie: add blast-radius defaults: 5% for 15m canary, scope by region + customer-tier. also KV warmup gate for large-KV models (require prefix-cache-hit >=70% before ramp).
jamal: make emergency opt-out visible to oncall and add a prominent rollback button in modal.
oncall-bot: Reminder created: "Rollout safety short-check" weekly Mon 10:00 starting 2026-03-30. Attendees: eng-platform, eng-runtime.
elaine: action summary: 1) opt-out flag -> anya -> 2026-03-31; 2) auto-rollback + harness -> mike -> 2026-04-02; 3) console caps & audit -> jamal -> 2026-04-06; 4) KV gate + telemetry -> sophie+anya -> 2026-04-02. i'll add these to the tracking sheet and update the postmortem doc. reply if anything missing. :white_check_mark:
